evidence_boundary: M04 acceptance proves a 12-case repository-shaped Go regression corpus covering cross-file references, package isolation, same-package and external tests, build-tag-visible references, assembly fail-closed behavior, generated-file references, and nested package findings. Synchronized candidate e204829bf14174fd1a3a5dc92e5bc351af4b6b63 passed strict governance run 36279198224 and three-OS CI run 36279198188; the M04 corpus reports 7 TP, 0 FP, and 0 FN while M02 and M03 remain passing. No Go detector implementation code changed in M04. These are synthetic repository-shaped corpus results, not general real-world precision or recall.
